scope: Home density and hierarchy changes in the frozen GUI source only; no Cargo, GUI, or native acceptance was run.
review: Source review found the identity column width is shared between heading and rows through USER_IDENTITY_WIDTH, row selection still uses the existing seat-identity widget ID and 'Select user N' observer/consume guard, and names retain bounded rendering with the complete value in the tooltip. The separate selected-user status row is removed; readiness remains available in the selected row tooltip. Default Home status chrome is suppressed only for the exact default message, while non-default status and dropped-packet warnings remain visible. The Start/Stop buttons use the existing script observation and consume-action guard; Start retains graph, failed-cleanup, quit, and close-state checks, while Pause/Resume and Stop enablement and dispatch remain unchanged. The existing routing-options disclosure IDs, measured route sizing, clipping, and 32–96 px options viewport bounds are retained; roster reserve is reduced from 84 to 64 px to account for the removed selected-status line.
limitations: This review does not establish that the full Multi keyboard row or footer is visible at all window sizes; visual acceptance must verify it.
No claim is made about overall MouseMux UX parity or broad ProtoInputMux completion.
